# December Lights: central start hint

The cover keeps the whole map visible while restoring a small, translucent start cue beside the central streetlamp. The four district labels stay below the artwork.

Each image compares the previous production cover (left) with this change (right):

- [Chinese, 390px](comparison-zh-390.webp)
- [English, 390px](comparison-en-390.webp)
- [Chinese, 1440px](comparison-zh-1440.webp)
- [English, 1440px](comparison-en-1440.webp)

Screenshots use Chrome viewport simulations. The central cue is part of the same clickable lamp hotspot; `app.js` updates its text with the active language.
